summary.text: Randy Langkraehr is the Libertarian Party nominee for Missouri's 5th District and vice chair of the Libertarian Party of Missouri. A Kansas City native who has owned small businesses, he has run for Congress several times as a Libertarian.

paragraphs.text: Born in Kansas City, Missouri, and raised in Emma, Missouri; completed an associate degree and then earned a B.A. at Central Missouri State University.

While in college he worked as a medication technician and held an emergency medical technician license; he has owned and operated a tax and bookkeeping office, a real estate office and a marketing company.

Ran as the Libertarian candidate against Emanuel Cleaver in the 2012 election for the 5th District, lost the 2014 Libertarian primary in the 4th District, and advanced from the 2022 Libertarian primary in the 4th District.
Serves as vice chair of the Libertarian Party of Missouri; KCUR reports he has no campaign website and that his personal Facebook page focuses on affordability.
